mechanisms.mechanism: an outer deadline does not bound an inner blocking wait such as CompletionService.take()
mechanisms.permanent_rule: every blocking primitive in a bounded operation derives its timeout from remaining monotonic deadline
mechanisms.regression_obligation: inject a never-completing worker and prove operation returns within declared deadline plus scheduler tolerance

mechanisms.evidence: BETA07 identity incident plus AX15GO PR #6
mechanisms.mechanism: a stable invariant applied before later reconstruction/version transforms can be silently reintroduced afterward
mechanisms.permanent_rule: stable invariants are applied/revalidated after all version-specific transforms and final artifact is the oracle
mechanisms.regression_obligation: late patch reintroduces stale identity; final gate must repair or reject it

mechanisms.evidence: BuildHub PR #10/#11 line exposed cross-platform fsync semantics
mechanisms.mechanism: hash/readback can succeed from OS cache before acknowledged bytes or final publication metadata are durably flushed
mechanisms.permanent_rule: critical acknowledged artifacts/secrets require platform-qualified durability boundary before COMMITTED; noncritical telemetry remains outside blanket fsync
mechanisms.regression_obligation: Linux+Windows fault injection around temp flush, replace, final-name flush and acknowledgement

mechanisms.evidence: G6.0.22 DPAPI flush gap remains runtime-unchanged while vNext PR #10 adds a candidate primitive
mechanisms.mechanism: engineering/spec improvements can be mistaken for a deployed runtime fix
mechanisms.permanent_rule: sealed runtime status changes only after rebuilt/rehashed/requalified artifact and matching field evidence
mechanisms.regression_obligation: reporting must reject FIXED/FIELD_VERIFIED when only vNext/design files changed

mechanisms.evidence: PROJECT-DRAFTS fence merged; dedicated BROWSER4G PR #1 adds machine-verifiable placeholder gate
mechanisms.mechanism: a dedicated repository can be mistaken for canonical authority while source remains elsewhere
mechanisms.permanent_rule: promotion requires explicit authority manifest, exact source SHA/hash inventory, destination readback and one writable authority
mechanisms.regression_obligation: bootstrap must reject placeholder repo while authority fence says NOT_CANONICAL

mechanisms.mechanism: overall elapsed time can be bounded while hundreds of queued probe tasks still inflate allocation/cancellation tail on a low-resource device
mechanisms.permanent_rule: bounded operations also bound queued/in-flight work, not only wall-clock wait
mechanisms.regression_obligation: large candidate set must keep submitted/in-flight probes below fixed window while preserving deadline

mechanisms.mechanism: temporary CI artifact retention can silently become the only copy of an Android signing identity; expiry then destroys in-place update continuity
mechanisms.permanent_rule: signing cache is never sole recovery authority; cache miss fails closed and separately verified encrypted recovery copy is a field gate
mechanisms.regression_obligation: simulate expired CI artifact and prove no new signing key is generated/substituted

mechanisms.mechanism: artifact publication and COMMITTED receipt are two durable objects; failure after receipt replace can make blind artifact rollback contradict a surviving receipt
mechanisms.permanent_rule: once matching COMMITTED receipt may have crossed replace boundary, state is reconciled/read back or COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; no blind rollback/replay
mechanisms.regression_obligation: inject error after receipt materialization and prove artifact is not blindly rolled back

mechanisms.mechanism: after interruption, source/artifact/receipt can survive in different combinations; generic retry cannot distinguish safe replay from conflict
mechanisms.permanent_rule: recovery classifies exact identities before replay: COMMITTED, NOT_COMMITTED, ARTIFACT_PRESENT_RECEIPT_MISSING, RECEIPT_PRESENT_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH or CONFLICT
mechanisms.regression_obligation: enumerate post-crash source/artifact/receipt combinations and verify side-effect-free classification

mechanisms.mechanism: new dedicated repository can inherit source code later but omit global agent/CI-budget constraints during placeholder/bootstrap stage
mechanisms.permanent_rule: dedicated repository inherits mandatory agent and CI-budget policy before any product authority migration
mechanisms.regression_obligation: placeholder verifier allows only declared bootstrap files and requires inherited AGENTS/CI budget policy

mechanisms.mechanism: one apparently green signal (process, heartbeat, discovery, repository existence, artifact existence, HTTP /health, provider mirror) can coexist with a failed useful command path, unwritable durable state, stale authority, wrong identity or degraded dependency
mechanisms.permanent_rule: health is a typed vector; no single supporting signal can promote end-to-end healthy, UNKNOWN/STALE are non-green, and independent dependencies are degraded separately rather than collapsing local core health
mechanisms.regression_obligation: inject green liveness with broken command/storage/authority/freshness dimensions in every project adapter and prove no false healthy promotion

mechanisms.mechanism: a correct health/context/readiness observation can become stale between observation and action because session, transport, topology, runtime, destination, revision, identity or coordinator generation changes
mechanisms.permanent_rule: health/readiness evidence is capability-scoped and generation-bound; generation changes invalidate immediately; process restart drops in-memory leases; wall clock is secondary; mutations recheck authoritative revision/fence/idempotency/storage preconditions at effect boundary; no full health scan enters every turn
mechanisms.regression_obligation: green evidence -> relevant generation change -> action must refresh/reject; unrelated dimension change must not invalidate unrelated capability; process restart cannot reuse old lease; wall-clock skew cannot extend mutation authority
